description: Merge chains: named item families with ordered levels. Dotted ids namespace chains to their board (e.g. atelier.notions). Chains with id "TBD" are design placeholders — the importer skips them with a log, not an error. Level displayNames arrive during the detailing phase; art_notes carries the art hook and itemId until then.

_comment.description: Optional human note; ignored by validation and importers.

_note.description: Design-team note; ignored by validation and importers.

board.description: Board namespace this chain belongs to (e.g. atelier, park).

art_notes.description: Art hook / itemId / detailing notes for this level.

itemId.description: Unique item id for this level (unique across all chains).

name.description: Canonical display name from the design package.

artHook.description: Canonical art hook for this level.

baseValue.description: Base merge/economy value; design uses 1..512 doubling.

schemaVersion.description: Optional; when present must be the expected version. Missing versions log a warning on import.

title: MergeChains
